description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for articles in a web application, implementing the command handler pattern with MediatR. It contains logic to update article data, including title, description, body, and tags, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Encapsulates the functionality for editing an article, including nested record types for data transfer and the handler implementation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of updating an article based on the provided command, handling data fetching, validation, updating, and saving.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to an article during update.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be removed from an article during update.
